name: Oku-sama wa Miko?
source:
Two childhood friends suddenly confess to protagonist. During the golden week he must decide which one he likes the most. Shrine maiden? Magic girl? Or maybe another childhood friend of maid type?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-april-2001-mizuiro.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
两个青梅竹马突然向主角告白。在黄金周期间，他必须决定自己最喜欢哪一个。巫女？魔法少女？还是另一个女仆型的青梅竹马？

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-april-2001-mizuiro.html]vndbreview[/url]]
